name: Satra
subtitle: Plex & Jellyfin Media Player for iOS
description: Official AltStore & SideStore source for Satra on iOS and iPadOS.

apps.name: Satra
apps.subtitle: Beautiful Plex & Jellyfin client
apps.localizedDescription: Satra is a fast, native Liquid Glass media player for Plex and Jellyfin on iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and TV with HDR playback, offline downloads, Watch Together, and multi-server profiles.
apps.versionDescription: Native iOS Liquid Glass UI refinements, flush top-right menu pill, aligned bottom Search orb, and progressive Continue Watching backdrop darkening.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera is used to scan QR codes for Companion Remote pairing.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: This app needs to connect to your media servers on your local network.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Satra uses location access when iOS requires it to detect your local network and connect to your media servers.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Satra needs photo library access so you can choose images to upload as media artwork.

versions.localizedDescription: Native iOS Liquid Glass UI refinements, flush top-right menu pill, aligned bottom Search orb, and progressive Continue Watching backdrop darkening.
